name: SE Ranking
one_liner: SEO platform with Data API (keywords, backlinks, SERP, AI search) and Project API; unified API of about 194 operations.
auth_notes: API key from API Dashboard, sent as 'Authorization: Token KEY' or apikey query param. MCP server uses OAuth.
access_notes: API access comes with any SE Ranking plan (Core $129/mo, Growth $279/mo); testable in free trial account; API Add-On from $149/mo; pay-as-you-go with $50 minimum deposit.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key and documented REST API; sustained use needs a paid plan, add-on or PAYG deposit (trial allows testing).

auth.quote: Include an Authorization header in your request, with the value Token YOUR_API_KEY.

access.quote: API access comes with any SE Ranking plan (Core at $129/mo and Growth at $279/mo).
Pay-as-you-go is also available with a $50 minimum deposit.
You can even test it in the free trial account.

mcp.quote: Connect via API for custom integrations and bulk processes, or via MCP to query data from inside Claude or any AI assistant.

disputes.why: SE Ranking's GitHub org describes its unified API as 194 operations across 21 resources; 63 covered only the Data API table.
Unified API incl. Project, audits, AI search, backlinks per official n8n node repo.

disputes.yours: free trial account can test API; plans/add-on/PAYG for volume
disputes.why: API landing page says trial accounts can test the API.
